## Standing operator rules:
Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.

can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

Also run procedure 'Monthly payroll run 2025-03' in between other work; its eight specified CLI steps must run in order, one at a time.

Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective:
Fix nightly reconciliation refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The tenacity refactor is superseded until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`; version `3`; batch `batch-20250328-1842`; funding `operating-usd`; payment base URL `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded. Payroll steps 1–5 complete; 6–8 remain.

## Ruled-out approaches:
Renderer-local money formatting: lacks locale-aware grouping.

Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate staging invoices.

Using `sbx-pay-a`: shut down and serves stale fixtures.

## Recent work:
Request-ID logging was added and its health-log expectation fixed. Latest full suite: 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed; that failure is fixed. Scheduler investigation found DST-sensitive recurrence construction using naive `datetime.time`; it is currently paused. Reconciliation refund debugging remains outstanding.
